lesson.subtitle: Lesson 3 -- My World, My Routine: The Day That Is Yours
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Joice Lopes Leite | Lesson 3 -- My World, My Routine
lesson.grammar_point: present simple negative and questions (don't / doesn't / do / does)

listenings.text: Hello, and welcome to your new week. Here is a small idea for you. You do not need one hour every day. You need ten minutes. In the morning, before the phone, read one page in English. Do not translate it. Do not stop at every word. Read the page, close the book, and go to work. Ten minutes, every morning. In one month, that is five hours of English. You do not need more time. You need the same small time, every day.

Good afternoon. This is a message about the visit to Ibirapuera Park on Saturday. The group meets at nine in the morning, at the main entrance. We walk for one hour, and then we have coffee. Please do not bring the car. The park does not have parking on Saturday morning. If it rains, we do not go, and I send a new message. Bring water, and bring a friend. See you on Saturday.

extra_audio.text: Joice wakes up early in the morning. She reads one page in English before work. She goes to the park for a walk. She does not work on Saturday afternoon. She comes home and reads a book with her family.
